title: Electromagnetic Induction
seo_title: Electromagnetic Induction Class 12 Physics Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Chapter 6)
standard_text: Electromagnetic induction; Faraday's laws, induced EMF and current; Lenz's law, self and mutual induction.
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 12 Physics worksheets for NCERT Chapter 6 Electromagnetic Induction: magnetic flux, Faraday's and Lenz's laws, motional e.m.f., eddy currents, self and mutual inductance and the AC generator. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: The induced current opposes the change (Lenz).
body_html:
How to think about it

Magnetic flux Φ = BA cos θ is measured in webers. Faraday's law says a changing flux linkage induces an e.m.f. ε = −N dΦ/dt; Lenz's law gives the minus sign — the induced current opposes the change, as energy conservation requires. A rod moving through a field has motional e.m.f. Blv.

A changing current in a coil induces a back e.m.f. L dI/dt in itself (self-inductance) and M dI/dt in a nearby coil (mutual inductance). An inductor stores energy ½LI². Eddy currents are reduced by laminating cores.

Example

B = 0.5 T, l = 1 m, v = 4 m/s?

Blv

Answer: 2 V

Example

L = 2 H, I = 3 A. Energy?

½ × 2 × 9

Answer: 9 J

Common mistakes

  • Forgetting to multiply by the number of turns.
  • Thinking Lenz's law helps the change.
  • Using L I instead of ½LI².
